purpose: Freeze the completed B0-B5 investigation, design, implementation, independent validation, and negative end-to-end proof for Status Source freshness provenance. This checkpoint records the verified owning layer and failure behavior without reopening legacy Project Doctor D1/D5 or semantic domains.

completedStages.statement: Legacy Project Doctor D1/D5 is not the live owner for this issue; current work must stay in the NEW Status Source / Project Status / Project Check authority chain.
The live freshness-provenance gap was traced to Status Source authority binding rather than legacy D1/D5 runtime.
Failure behavior was fixed as deterministic raw-byte provenance: same path and same bytes is fresh; same path with changed bytes must fail closed.
Minimal design was fixed under the status-source owner, with no semantic recomputation and no legacy Doctor reactivation.

R1 Status Source captures and validates deterministic git-blob-sha1 source provenance, existing APPROVED entries were bootstrapped, and exact approved-source paths were explicitly co-owned by status-source in Project Check.
A one-line byte-only mutation to an approved Banner primary source produced STALE_SOURCE_PROVENANCE and Project Check BLOCKER/BLOCKED_VALIDATOR while unrelated domains remained isolated.

decision.statement: Status Source authority is now bound to deterministic source-content provenance and fails closed on same-path byte changes. B0-B5 are complete and frozen; remaining reviews are non-blocking tooling or future-event proofs.

reopenConditions: The NEW Status Source authority or provenance contract materially changes.
An APPROVED Status Source can select a source whose current bytes do not match its recorded provenance without failing closed.
A same-path byte mutation is no longer detected as stale by the owning Status Source validator.
Project Check no longer routes an approved primary source through the explicit status-source owner.
Project Check begins owner propagation or change-class fan-out for this path class.
An owning provenance validator failure no longer blocks the required project-check.
Legacy Project Doctor D1/D5 becomes an active runtime dependency of the NEW authority chain.
New authoritative evidence contradicts the frozen B0-B6 result.
